method: Sources extracted with git show origin/cert/local-main-b142cf8:<path> into a clean dir, executed with the py3.11 interpreter that has the SDK. Core self-test --self-test exit 0, 147 lines, RESULT::CLEAN_LIVE_COPY_CORE_SELF_TEST_PASS. Import probe of classify_integrity_severity. AST enumeration of .order( sites and _place_order/_send_real callers. Exhaustive enumeration of entry-gate block L6352-6376 and of truth_tier/freshness attributes. Live render of :8031 (87350 bytes). No order placed, no credential read.
notes: CARD/REALITY MISMATCH: card says :8031 is PID 33368 serving 89b3bc7. Actual listener is PID 26592 and the page carries no commit marker; UI row bound to live DOM plus commit-bound SSOT at b142cf8.

Every row is FAIL on a mechanism ABSENT or CONTRADICTED in the engine at b142cf8, reproducible offline; the register's testnet replay route is additionally blocked by open decision D-002, which is why FAIL and not NOT_TESTED is used.

rows.evidence_ref: grep -ci desired over Core = 0 and over HL_Copy_App_SSOT.py = 0. Sizing per leader fill: self-test requirement#5 'ENTRY keeps fixed-notional sizing :: copy_size=5.0', requirement#6 'EXIT keeps full-sleeve sizing :: copy_size=50.0'. Order decision path L2655-2675 (caps only) then _place_order L2707-2715.
rows.why: Row requires orders generated solely from desired_position - actual_position; the core has no desired-position concept (0 hits) and sizes each order from the individual leader fill. That is exactly the known failure ARCHITECTURE.md says the repair removes.

rows.evidence_ref: compare_snapshot L5868-5892 writes LEDGER_EXCHANGE_NET_MISMATCH with notes 'no auto-correction' and returns a string. Entry gates L6352-6376 enumerate exactly five block reasons (WS_FEED_STALE, COPY_POLL_STALE, UNRECONCILED_FILLED_SENDS, TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_WALLETS, _daily_loss_block). grep exchange_recon_status: assigned L6480-6493, never read by a gate. grep halt = 0.
rows.why: Mismatch is audited but consumed by no gate: wallet stays LIVE, entries continue, no halt/close-only transition. Comparison is against local ledger, not a desired position.

rows.evidence_ref: Send authority is SenderGateway L2678; _place_order L2707 'The ONE physical exchange order call'; chain L6293 send_if_allowed -> L3298 _send_real -> L2715 exchange.order. ExchangeReconciler L5662 has only fetch_snapshot/compare_snapshot and holds no sender.
rows.why: Single send path holds, but the reconciler is not the send authority and no drift-detector blocker is consumed before send, so an observed drift cannot stop the next order.

rows.evidence_ref: Live :8031 render 87350 bytes title 'Live Copy Dashboard' (PID 26592): grep freshness = 0, truth_tier = 0 (also 0 in SSOT and Core at b142cf8). Page exposes write endpoints /api/live-config/set-mode, set-wallet, add-wallet, remove-wallet, /api/global-controls via button id=lcGcSave and CLO/OFF buttons.
rows.why: No displayed value carries truth tier or freshness, so exchange truth cannot be distinguished from cache; and the dashboard is a write surface, not a read-only projection.

rows.evidence_ref: Exchange read used for ownership (L2750-2766) and caps (L2524-2540 via follower_exposure L2492-2519). But wallet cap L2660-2661 current = self.ledger.wallet_abs_exposure_usd(...) (L2194-2202 sums local by_wallet sleeves). Settle window L2490-2491 returns the last local verdict _coin_clean instead of a fresh exchange read.
rows.why: Wallet-exposure admission and the 10s settle window treat the local ledger as actual exposure; a mis-stated local sleeve changes whether an order is admitted.

rows.evidence_ref: L2945 close_size = min(abs(wallet_pos), abs(wire_size), abs(intent.copy_size)) with wallet_pos = sleeve signed_size. Executed self-test check 40: 'wallet A exit clamped to wallet A sleeve not coin_net :: copy_size=5.0 coin_net=2.0'. grep openOrders|open_orders over Core = 0.
rows.why: Self-test prints the counterexample: account coin_net 2.0 but exit clamped to wallet sleeve 5.0, so sizing follows the per-wallet sleeve; no open-order read exists so open-order exposure cannot participate.

rows.evidence_ref: AST: one .order( call at L2715 in SenderGateway._place_order; callers L2955, L3065, L3613, L3634 all in the same class. grep -ci converg over Core = 0; convergence_shadow.py never imported (imports L20-40). Master switch only at send_if_allowed L3261; _send_real L3310 and _place_order L2707 do not re-assert it.
rows.why: One physical call site is real, but the named convergence sender is absent and the master disable switch is checked once at admission, not at the send site, so the direct recovery callers never re-check it.

rows.evidence_ref: Recovery states classified (self-test 122-127 PASS incl EXIT_RECOVERY_QUEUED->EXIT_RECOVERY_ACTIVE, ENGINE_CLOSE_RETRY_REQUIRED, MANUAL_EXIT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED). But _queue_exit_recovery_if_needed L2931-2960 calls self._place_order at L2955 directly and the rate-limit recovery calls it at L3065, neither via send_if_allowed L3255 nor the reconciler L5662.
rows.why: Recovery is first-class but does not request convergence through the reconciler: two recovery paths place orders directly, bypassing the single admission gate and any desired-vs-actual reconciliation.

rows.evidence_ref: __init__ L5995-6015: ledger = ManualLedger() (local manual_live_positions.json, L130), dedupe from SERVICE_STATE/CORE_RUNTIME_STATE, idempotency seeded from local SEND_ATTEMPTS_CSV; reconciler only constructed L6026 and fetch_snapshot runs inside run_cycle gated on --reconcile-exchange (L7977, L8026) or copy-poll L6470-6482. Only guard is timestamp-based stale_snapshot_replay_reason L515-525.
rows.why: Restart begins from the local position ledger with no fresh exchange or leader snapshot; unless --reconcile-exchange is passed the first cycles treat local positions as authority - the restart-on-local-replay defect.

rows.evidence_ref: grep -ci canary over Core = 0; no single-wallet/asset policy. MAX_WALLETS from HL_LIVE_WS_MAX_WALLETS default '10' (L211; used L2014, L6371, L8001). Caps optional, default off: max_order_notional L2021 and max_total_exposure L1999 return max(0.0,...); consumers guard '> 0' at L2661, L2533.
rows.why: Canary-first is a configuration convention, not enforced behaviour: default cohort is up to 10 wallets and every notional cap defaults to disabled, with no asset restriction.

rows.evidence_ref: CONTROL_STATE.json has only operator_hold (OPERATOR_HOLD_ACTIVE, richard:operator, 2026-10-14T14:12:00Z, 'drain then pause') - no truth-failure freeze or 'until reconciler invariant proven' trigger. EVIDENCE/DECISIONS.md holds only D-001 and D-002. Non-core machinery not demoted: convergence_shadow.py 12523 bytes, legacy HL_Live_Copy_Service.py 281821 bytes with its own exchange.order at L1036, core 8042 lines.
rows.why: No freeze-on-truth-failure record or mechanism exists and no non-core machinery was removed or demoted; the only freezes are documentation/intent and an operator hold.

rows.evidence_ref: ARCHITECTURE.md L31 cites architecture-level ruling B3-A2C-GATE0-PASS-G1-1 and prescribes leader lineage -> desired account-net -> convergence planner. Deployed core: grep desired = 0, grep converg = 0, orders still per leader fill (self-test requirement#5 copy_size=5.0).
rows.why: Architecture permission exists and the architecture-level repair was specified, but the shipped engine still applies the per-fill patch the contract replaces - patching around ROOT-001, with the defect class unchanged.

rows.evidence_ref: git grep -i 'rebuild owner|accountable owner|single rebuild owner|ownership of GREEN-ONLY' over origin/cert/local-main-b142cf8 -- '*.md' = 0 hits. CONTROL_STATE.json keys: schema, project, updated_utc, operator_hold - no owner field. Register carries the requirement twice (F-ARCH-015 and the paired accountable-owner row) but no artifact names an owner.
rows.why: No rebuild owner for GREEN-ONLY-001 is assigned in any shipped control document, so no contributor can prove against a named owner's invariant; the surfaces that would carry it exist and are empty of it.

rows.evidence_ref: No desired/target exposure per coin (grep desired = 0). Only per-coin actual check is ENG-016 unowned inventory L2484-2499, blocking ENTRY/ADD when exchange net != ledger net, not when exposure is at/beyond target. Caps optional default 0 (L1999, L2021; consumers guard > 0). Self-test requirement#5: ENTRY fixed notional copy_size=5.0.
rows.why: With no desired target and caps off by default each successive leader ADD produces another fixed-notional follower ADD; the one per-coin test compares ownership, not exposure versus target.

rows.evidence_ref: Hot path sends WS fills with no exchange read: _enqueue_hot_ws_fill -> _hot_queue -> _hot_send_loop L6062-6075 -> _process_leader_fill -> send_if_allowed -> _send_real -> _place_order L2715. Pre-send exchange input is a persisted file: _persisted_exchange_positions L2750-2766 loads EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT_SNAPSHOT_FILE with no age check. Executed probe classify_integrity_severity -> SNAPSHOT_SKIPPED GREEN, SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE GREEN, UNCLASSIFIED GREEN, only UNKNOWN RED.
rows.why: WS is more than a trigger: fills are sent from the hot loop without a REST/exchange snapshot, the ownership gate reads a possibly stale snapshot with no freshness bound, and snapshot-skipped/unavailable states publish GREEN.
